entries.title: James 2:1
segments: ¶My brethren, do not hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, [the Lord] of glory, with partiality.

entries.title: James 2:2
segments: For if there should come into your assembly a man with gold rings, in fine apparel, and there should also come in a poor man in filthy clothes,

entries.title: James 2:3
segments: and you pay attention to the one wearing the fine clothes and say to him, "You sit here in a good place," and say to the poor man, "You stand there," or, "Sit here at my footstool,"

entries.title: James 2:4
segments: have you not shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

entries.title: James 2:5
segments: Listen, my beloved brethren: Has God not chosen the poor of this world [to be] rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom which He promised to those who love Him?

entries.title: James 2:6
segments: But you have dishonored the poor man. Do not the rich oppress you and drag you into the courts?

entries.title: James 2:7
segments: Do they not blaspheme that noble name by which you are called?

entries.title: James 2:8
segments: ¶If you really fulfill [the] royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you do well;

entries.title: James 2:9
segments: but if you show partiality, you commit sin, and are convicted by the law as transgressors.

entries.title: James 2:10
segments: For whoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one [point], he is guilty of all.

entries.title: James 2:11
segments: For He who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." Now if you do not commit adultery, but you do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

entries.title: James 2:12
segments: So speak and so do as those who will be judged by the law of liberty.

entries.title: James 2:13
segments: For judgment is without mercy to the one who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

entries.title: James 2:14
segments: ¶What [does it] profit, my brethren, if someone says he has faith but does not have works? Can faith save him?

entries.title: James 2:15
segments: If a brother or sister is naked and destitute of daily food,

entries.title: James 2:16
segments: and one of you says to them, "Depart in peace, be warmed and filled," but you do not give them the things which are needed for the body, what [does it] profit?

entries.title: James 2:17
segments: Thus also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead.

entries.title: James 2:18
segments: But someone will say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

entries.title: James 2:19
segments: You believe that there is one God. You do well. Even the demons believe--and tremble!

entries.title: James 2:20
segments: But do you want to know, O foolish man, that faith without works is dead?

entries.title: James 2:21
segments: Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he offered Isaac his son on the altar?

entries.title: James 2:22
segments: Do you see that faith was working together with his works, and by works faith was made perfect?

entries.title: James 2:23
segments: And the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness." And he was called the friend of God.

entries.title: James 2:24
segments: You see then that a man is justified by works, and not by faith only.

entries.title: James 2:25
segments: Likewise, was not Rahab the harlot also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent [them] out another way?

entries.title: James 2:26
segments: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
